title: Hot Jupiter Vanishes from Sight After Gravitational Tug from Unseen Neighbor

summary: Astronomers analyzing seven years of TESS data discovered that a hot Jupiter about 1,000 light-years away stopped transiting its star. They determined that an unseen massive companion planet gravitationally tugged the world off its previous transit alignment.

summary: Nearly 50 years after its launch in 1977, Voyager 1 is set to cross the one light-day distance threshold, sitting more than 16 billion miles away from Earth. NASA is marking the historic interplanetary milestone with public engagement events and global participation.
